newsitem.title: USA: Kansas fed cattle trade very slow at $63 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas fed cattle trade very slow at $63 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was very slow, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers not well established, few sales steady. Inquiry fair, demand light.

Sales confirmed on 200 slaughter steers and 300 slaughter heifers Wednesday. For the week to date 78,100 head confirmed including 24,000 head or about 31 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1200 lbs 63.00. Dressed basis - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1025 lbs 99.00 with light weight carcasses (under 535 lbs) discounted $25.00.

Slaughter heifers - Pen mixed Commercial to Choice 1050 lb heifers and heiferettes 61.00. Dressed basis - Few Select and Choice 2-3 975-1025 lbs 99.00 with light weight carcasses (under 535 lbs) discounted $25.00.
Wk to date - 78,100 last week - 23,400 last year - 83,500
